ad_info.structure_source: library format F43 (Fondo oscuro con sirena de urgencia, lista de 3 ofertas y botón) — estructuras/mv-13.json
ad_info.reference_style: Premium dark still-life offer ad: huge 4-line headline with one highlighted farewell word, short context paragraph, 3 offer lines with icons, big bottle with plants and a lit siren behind it, wide button
ad_info.angle_used: Oferta / promoción — the goodbye is not to a price but to the loose jean at the back (pain: already bought pills online and saw nothing)

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: near-black plum #1A0A17 background and deep palm green #1F4A2E for the leaves.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium dark still life with dramatic rim light; the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo; a real phone-photo inset of the woman's problem.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Urgent and decisive but honest: a fuchsia siren glow says 'time to say goodbye', with no countdown and no scarcity claims.
global_identity.graphic_language: Very heavy white uppercase type, one fuchsia highlighted word, white line icons inside fuchsia circles, a wide rounded fuchsia button, a bordered registration badge, a photo inset with a thin white frame.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look).

creative_objective: Stop the scroll with a farewell headline that turns the classic 'goodbye to our price' urgency into 'goodbye to the loose jean at the back', show the pain in a real mirror photo, and close with three honest offer lines (complete x3 treatment, pay on delivery, 2 capsules a day) and a wide button.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the 4-line headline with ADIÓS in fuchsia, 2) the mirror photo inset and the big bottle with the siren glow, 3) the short context paragraph, 4) the 3 offer lines with icons, 5) the wide button and the registration badge.
art_direction.composition_style: Text column on the left half from top to bottom; the right half holds the photo inset on top and the bottle with palm leaves and siren in the middle; the button spans the bottom left with the badge at the bottom right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Left margin 5%; headline, paragraph and offer list stacked with even gaps; the bottle overlaps the lower edge of the inset slightly to create depth; button and badge share one baseline.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Dark low-key studio; hard fuchsia rim light from the right on the bottle; a soft fuchsia bloom from the siren behind; palm leaves half in shadow; a glossy dark tabletop with a soft reflection under the bottle.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 45%: 4-line headline in white with the farewell word in color at top-left, followed by a short context paragraph with one bold phrase. Middle 35%: left, 3 offer lines each with an icon; right, the big bottle with plants at its base and a lit siren glowing behind it. Bottom 20%: a wide rounded button on the left. Added by batch rules: a real photo inset of the woman's problem at the top right (about 25% of the canvas) and a bordered registration badge next to the button.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: pills that did nothing vs a natural 3-month plan, no countdown or stock claims
complete x3 treatment, pay on delivery, 2 capsules a day; white line icons in fuchsia circles
the real closed bottle with aguaje palm fronds behind it
fuchsia rotating beacon glowing, no text on it
hot fuchsia rounded button with white text

detected_visual_blocks.block_type: photo inset of the problem (batch rule)
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: real phone mirror photo, loose jeans at the back
rounded badge with solid fuchsia border and shield icon

forbidden_additions: Countdown timers, 'últimas unidades', 'se agota', stock or restock claims, dates
Prices, percentages, discounts, 'gratis', 'envío gratis', guarantees, money-back claims
Loose capsules or an open bottle
Flowers of any other color than the palm leaves described

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium dark still-life offer ad. BACKGROUND: near-black plum #1A0A17 fading to dark plum #2B1226, with a soft hot-fuchsia #E6177F glow behind the bottle on the right; a glossy dark tabletop across the lower third. TOP-LEFT ZONE (4–30% height, 5–52% width): 4-line headline in Montserrat Black uppercase, tight leading, flush left: line 1 'DILE' white, line 2 'ADIÓS' in hot fuchsia #E6177F, slightly larger, line 3 'AL JEAN QUE' white, line 4 'BAILA ATRÁS' white; letters crisp and huge. LEFT (31–44% height, 5–50% width): a 3-line context paragraph in white Poppins Regular with the phrase 'plan natural de 3 meses' in white Poppins Bold. TOP-RIGHT PHOTO INSET (3–58% height, 52–97% width, about 25% of the canvas): a real vertical smartphone photo with a thin 6 px white frame and rounded corners, slightly tilted 2 degrees: a Colombian woman around 28, wavy chestnut hair in a loose low ponytail, light-tan skin with visible pores and a little shine, cropped white cotton t-shirt, light-wash blue jeans, standing three-quarters from the back in front of a bedroom wardrobe mirror, holding her phone, looking over her shoulder at her own back with a disappointed half-frown; the denim hangs loose and flat below the back pockets with a soft fold of extra fabric, the pockets drooping; warm yellow ceiling light, unmade bed edge in the mirror, slight phone grain. MIDDLE-LEFT (47–76% height, 5–50% width): 3 offer lines, each with a 64 px hot-fuchsia circle holding a white thin-line icon on the left (an open hand with a small box; a delivery box with a coin; a small calendar with a check) and bold white Poppins Bold text beside it, evenly spaced. RIGHT (44–86% height, centered at 76% width): the real product bottle standing upright, about 40% of the canvas height, front-facing at label height, label perfectly readable; behind it two dark-green aguaje palm fronds (long fan-shaped leaves with straight narrow leaflets) half in shadow; behind the bottle's right shoulder a lit hot-fuchsia rotating siren beacon (translucent dome, glowing filament) casting fuchsia bloom, no text on it. Hard fuchsia rim light from the right on the bottle edge, soft key from the front-left, soft reflection on the dark tabletop. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh; three pink-outlined black boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' at the bottom. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; always closed, no loose capsules; label reads the right way round, never mirrored. BOTTOM ZONE (82–96% height): left (5–60% width) a wide rounded hot-fuchsia #E6177F button with a subtle inner glow and white Montserrat Black uppercase text centered; right (64–96% width) a rounded badge on dark plum with a solid 3 px hot-fuchsia border and a small white shield icon, holding the registration text in white Poppins Bold on two lines ('REGISTRO INVIMA' above the number). All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents, nothing else written.
